bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 63
cd "$root"
branch=chat/link-button-master-final-20261120
new=026842b8d1a5e25d9e26a7c0ab47f75bfacf1e04
files=(scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py scripts/userbot_link_flow_smoke.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py)
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$new" || exit 65
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-resident-script-candidate.XXXXXXXX)"
swapped=0
passed=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$passed" != 1; then
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do
   if test -f "$tmp/old/$f"; then cp "$tmp/old/$f" "$root/$f" || true
   else rm -f "$root/$f"; fi
  done
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
for f in "${files[@]}"; do
 mkdir -p "$tmp/old/$(dirname "$f")" "$tmp/new/$(dirname "$f")"
 git show "$new:$f" >"$tmp/new/$f" || exit 66
 if test -e "$f"; then
  test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || exit 67
  current_blob="$(git hash-object "$f")"
  known=0
  for commit in $(git log --format=%H "$new" -- "$f"); do
   history_blob="$(git rev-parse "$commit:$f" 2>/dev/null)" || continue
   if test "$current_blob" = "$history_blob"; then known=1; break; fi
  done
  test "$known" = 1 || exit 68
  cp "$f" "$tmp/old/$f"
 fi
done
python3 - "$tmp/new" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
for path in Path(sys.argv[1]).rglob("*.py"):
 compile(path.read_bytes(),str(path),"exec")
PY
for f in "${files[@]}"; do cp "$tmp/new/$f" "$f"; done
swapped=1
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 69
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 71
passed=1
echo RESIDENT_SCRIPTS_PROVENANCE=PASS
echo RESIDENT_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
